text:
alex: Heads-up — we need a short maintenance window tonight for APAC edge to mitigate rising tail latencies on some GPU hosts. Planning 02:30–03:30 SGT. This is a rolling capacity shuffle (no pool-wide drain) to restart NICs + driver on ~6 hosts that showed packet drops. Expected impact: 95th token latency could spike briefly for affected tenants while backfill completes.

tina: Which hosts? can we limit to standby racks only?

alex: Targeting hosts: apac-edge-rack-7 nodes [n07,n08,n09] + apac-edge-rack-8 [n02,n03]. They’re low-util this window; we’ll prefer spot/interruptible pools. No forced evictions — just cordon -> reboot -> uncordon.

ben: Will this affect Dedicated capacity customers pinned to those racks?

alex: Good q — no pinned dedicated capacity in those racks. Checked reservations and none are bound there. If anything critical shows during preflight we'll reschedule.

priya: How are we handling prefix/KV cache warmup? last time we saw an hour-long cold tail.

alex: Plan: seed KV caches from warmed neighbors before traffic switches, and enable shorter backoff so requests route to healthy hosts quickly. We’ll run this script ~15m before each reboot:

```
# seed kv cache on target cohort
for host in n07 n08 n09 n02 n03; do
  ./tools/kvseed --target $host --source warm-host-01
done
```

ben: Any cost implications for using extra warmbackfill capacity? approx how many GPUs we’ll spin up?

alex: We'll temporarily spin up 4 g4dn-equivalent standby GPUs for ~1h. Estimated incremental cost ~USD 120 for the window. Ops budget ok with that?

priya: Product comms — should we mention a brief increase in generation latency in status page?

alex: Yes, will post a brief advisory to status: “potential short-lived latency spikes in APAC edge during maintenance window”. I’ll draft and ping you for review.

infra-bot: Scheduled job created: maintenance-apac-edge-2026-03-21 at 02:30 SGT. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/apac-edge-nic-restart

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: canary-group-3 -> executing 02:15 SGT

alex: Final checklist before lock: 1) confirm standby GPUs up (ben) 2) QA canary green (deploy-bot) 3) run kvseed (alex) 4) status post drafted (priya). If anything fails we abort and reopen with new window. :thumbsup:

tina: I’ll watch networking metrics and be on-call for rollback.

ben: standby GPUs up now, monitoring cost meter.

priya: Draft ready, sending for a quick review in #product-comm.

alex: Thanks all — will trigger at 02:30. Keeping thread here for post-mortem notes. :rocket:
